method: Independent image-only reader; no source-code inspection. Not the full AnyCreature automated/thumbnail gate.

rounds.identification: An elderly cream-colored cat gentleman—round gold spectacles, white moustache, blue formal coat, purple waistcoat, and a cane.
rounds.verdict: Readable and appealing, but not fully polished.
findings: Unmistakably feline; ears, cheek tufts, stout proportions, and cane remain clear in silhouette.
Cheeks and muzzle have convincing depth. Eyes protrude like separately mounted domes, especially in the hero/profile views.
Coordinated colors and restrained gold details work well. Glossy shoes contrast nicely with clothing.
Coat shoulders and elbows have conspicuous lumpy seams, and the broad white neck cylinder looks unfinished.
The side silhouette shows several isolated chest-detail shapes sitting ahead of the torso; their connection needs inspection.
Feet and cane appear grounded; the bent-knee stance is readable but stiff. No obvious detached limb or major pose failure is visible.

rounds.verdict: Suitable as a recognizable local prototype, not yet high-polish character presentation.
findings: Visibly improved, particularly the neck and chest assembly. Still reads immediately as an elderly cat gentleman.
The exposed white neck cylinder is gone; head-to-coat transition is much cleaner. Chest layers sit closer to the body, and the previous conspicuously separated accents are reduced.

Raised spectacles and the hanging watch chain are intentional, not defects. I cannot confidently identify a genuinely detached body detail in these updated views; the tiny remaining profile projections are insufficient evidence.
Eyes still look mounted onto the face, with exposed white rims and a pronounced perimeter seam.
Shoulder/elbow transitions remain somewhat lumpy. The bent-knee stance is unchanged and slightly stiff, though feet and cane appear grounded.
Runtime and face-draft images show stronger faceted/banded shading across the eye whites and face than the smooth hero render. The runtime therefore does not yet match the hero's finish.
